title: Pay per Article
description_1: Pay Per Article lets visitors unlock gated content with a one-time payment.
description_2: It provides a clean, customizable interface to configure pricing, and choose how locked content is revealed.
section.settings.title: Settings
inputgroup.price.title: Price
inputgroup.price.desc: Set the one-time payment amount visitors pay to unlock this page’s gated content.
input.price.label: Amount
inputgroup.placement.title: Paywall placement
inputgroup.placement.desc: Choose how much of the page the paywall covers, and when it appears to the visitor.
input.coverage.label: Coverage on the page
input.coverage.hint: How much of the screen the paywall takes when it appears.
input.delay.label: Show paywall after
input.delay.hint: Maximum {{max}} seconds. Set to 0 to show the paywall immediately on page load.
input.title.label: Title
input.title.hint: Pick a suggestion or write your own — this is the paywall's heading.
input.message.label: Subtitle
input.message.placeholder: Unlock the full article with a one-time payment — no subscription, no account.
input.payButton.label: Pay button label
